title: Permutations
summary: Return every ordering of the supplied distinct integers.

contractDetails.output-checking: Require every distinct permutation once. Outer order is free and each permutation's internal order is significant.

statement: Return every ordering of the supplied distinct integers. Outer result order is free. Order within each permutation is significant.

examples.explanation: There are three choices for the first value and two for the second.

hints: Conceptual: A permutation chooses one unused value for each position.
Directional: Track which input positions are already used.
Implementation: Mark a value, recurse, then undo the mark. Save an independent copy of every completed ordering.
complexityAnalysis: O(n·n!) time including output, O(n) auxiliary space.
